texto: The substantial infinitive is written with capital and is neutral: **das Lesen**, **das Schwimmen**, **das Reisen**. It can be subject or complement: **Schwimmen ist gesund**; **Das Lesen entspannt mich**. It also declines: **beim Lesen** (when reading), **die Freude am Lesen** (the pleasure of reading).

The infinitive as a subject and **sein** + adjective are called general truths: **Sport zu treiben ist wichtig** (practicing sport is important). **Das Leben** may be the lexic name «life» or a substantial infinitive of **leben**; the context determines the reading.

frases.en: What are you doing this weekend?

frases.de: Ich treibe Sport, Wandern ist mein Lieblingshobby.
frases.es: Practico deporte; el senderismo es mi afición favorita.
frases.en: I practice sport; hiking is my favorite hobby.

frases.de: Schwimmen ist gesund, das Lesen entspannt mich auch.
frases.es: Nadar es sano; leer también me relaja.
frases.en: Swimming is healthy; reading also relaxes me.
